anchors.label: Left chest (medals)
anchors.note: No. 5 (shirt), Guidelines for uniform.pdf (project owner) No. 5(T) pp.13-14: medal ribbons (a ribbon bar), not hanging medals, above the left chest pocket, directly on the top edge of the pocket flap (flap top at y 219.5). Each ribbon is 17.6 x 12 px with a 1 px outline, three abreast with no gap (52.8 wide), centred at x 450, bottom edge y 219. The ribbons are cut out of the existing medal art (no new image), in the order picked. ASSUMPTION: the PDF gives no rule for more than 3 medals, so further rows stack upward, each centred on the bar. Position read off the picture, not calibrated.

anchors.label: Left chest, above pocket
anchors.note: No. 5 (shirt), Guidelines for uniform.pdf (project owner) pp.13-14: maximum 3 SAF badges in total, centred above the medal ribbons, about 12 px above the top of the ribbons (y 200.6 with one row of ribbons or none; the 6.4 px gap plus the padding of the art). Exceptional skills first. 1 or 2 badges are one row; 3 are a pyramid with about 6 px between the rows (rows overlap by 4.7 px of padding). Scale 0.96 of the standard 39 px box (about 30 to 35 px visible width), horizontal gap 9. minY 75 is the lowest the top may reach (checked by a test). Sizes chosen by eye with the project owner (approved draft 3), not from the regulations.

anchors.label: Right chest (foreign badges)
anchors.note: SAF No.1 Dress PDF (March 2024): maximum 3, centred, bottom edge 1 cm above the top edge of the right pocket flap or in line with the SAF badges (if worn), whichever is higher. pxPerMm is not calibrated. Moved with this drawing's pocket flaps (top edge y = 219.5; left flap centre x = 451, right 284), which sit 12 px lower than number-1's. Same placement rule as number-1 (project owner). Foreign badges: the PDF puts them centred on the right upper lapel with their centre 3 cm below the lapel notch (about x 290, y 133); we have no foreign badge art yet, so this spot is unchanged from number-1.

anchors.label: Left pocket flap
anchors.note: Moved with this drawing's pocket flaps (top edge y = 219.5; left flap centre x = 451, right 284), which sit 12 px lower than number-1's. Same placement rule as number-1 (project owner).

anchors.label: Right side
anchors.note: Source says 'right side of the uniform'. Exact spot unknown. Same placement as number-1 (project owner).

anchors.label: Left shoulder sleeve
anchors.note: Not more than two proficiency badges. SAF No.1 Dress PDF (March 2024) p.15: centred on the shoulder board, base of the LOWER badge 15 cm down the sleeve from the shoulder seam; marksmanship below the IPPT badge (project owner). Position is a guess (scale not calibrated). The perspective sprites come from the badge-art-pipeline bundle and still use the older "first badge 15 cm down" spacing, so they need a re-export. Same placement as number-1 (project owner). Stays on the sleeve on this dress (PDF: base of the IPPT badge 15 cm from the shoulder seam).

anchors.label: Left sleeve (tabs)
anchors.note: Maximum of two tabs. SAF No.1 Dress PDF (March 2024) p.15: centred on the shoulder board, 1 cm below the left shoulder seam, the second tab immediately before the first. Position is a guess (scale not calibrated). Same placement as number-1 (project owner).

anchors.label: Right collar (arms badge)
anchors.note: Guidelines for uniform.pdf (project owner): the arms (branch) badge is worn on the right collar (the viewer's left collar wing). A silver pin (art variant arms-silver). About 16 px visible width for the narrowest pin (infantry) and 16 to 18 px for the others (scale 1.058), upright, one badge, no copy, centred at about (330, 98), by the bottom corner of the collar, clear of the collar lines. Chosen by eye with the project owner, not calibrated.

anchors.label: Right sleeve (foreign tabs)
anchors.note: Maximum of two tabs, worn the same way as on the left sleeve (SAF No.1 Dress PDF (March 2024) p.15). Position is a guess (scale not calibrated). Same placement as number-1 (project owner).

anchors.label: Right sleeve (foreign badges)
anchors.note: Maximum of two badges, worn the same way as on the left sleeve (SAF No.1 Dress PDF (March 2024) p.15). Position is a guess (scale not calibrated). Same placement as number-1 (project owner).

anchors.label: Shoulders
anchors.note: One board on each shoulder, button at the collar end. Drawn from number-1's perspective sprites (mountedFrom), because the shoulders and sleeves are in the same place; see docs/PERSPECTIVE.md in the badge-art-pipeline project.

anchors.label: Right sleeve (rank)
anchors.note: Lowest point of the chevron 24 cm from the shoulder seam, centre in line with the centre of the shoulder board (SAF No.1 Dress PDF, March 2024, p.8). Only the front half shows from the front. Position is a guess (scale not calibrated). Same placement as number-1 (project owner).
